dimensions.assessment: Affects the Forest Service, the North Carolina Department of Transportation, the Federal Highway Administration, and the private entity requesting the memorial relocation.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Agriculture... may authorize, by special use authorization, the installation and any maintenance associated with the installation of the memorial

dimensions.assessment: Permits a single local memorial relocation without broader regulatory or policy consequences.
Explicitly prohibits the use of federal funds for the project, requiring requesting individuals or entities to cover all costs.
dimensions.evidence: No Federal funds may be used to relocate, install, or maintain the memorial under subsection (a).

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a single administrative action regarding a specific local memorial site under a special use authorization.
Provides a specific, one-time authorization for a memorial relocation with ongoing terms and conditions determined by the Secretary.

missing_information: Specific estimates of administrative processing costs.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes the Forest Service to allow the relocation of a specific memorial in North Carolina, with all costs borne by the requesting party and no federal funds used.
